_note: Tier 2, oldest end. February and March 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is being warned again about an earlier word on a great betrayal in which the United States turns its back on Israel, makes bad choices and does not support it, and that this opens up an attack.
mentions.quote: the great betrayal concerning the United States turning its back on Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A public American withdrawal of support for Israel followed by an attack on Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: American support holds. Undated, and support has continued through 2024, 2025 and 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him this will be called the great betrayal, that it is one of the demonic assignments sent to destroy America, and that prayer can stop it.
mentions.quote: they will call this the great betrayal
mentions.falsify_match: The phrase the great betrayal enters public use for an American abandonment of Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Naming the phrase people will use is unusually specific and therefore checkable.

mentions.claim_text: Declarative prayer over America for salvation, a turnaround, repentance over the wicked and over pride on the right, and awakening in the churches.
mentions.quote: America you shall be saved you shall be turned around
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: declarative intercession with no event, threshold or date.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the years of Jacob's trouble are at hand and that Jesus is coming, then prays for an outpouring, a catching away and a massive harvest of souls as one last push.
mentions.quote: years of Jacob's trouble is at hand people wake up
mentions.falsify_match: The tribulation begins.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. At hand carries no date, and the same phrase recurs across the corpus from 2023 onward.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a revival across America, asking for one last push even if it only lasts a couple of weeks, for the unsaved to be brought in, and for the nations to be shaken.
mentions.quote: we ask father for one push even if it just lasts a couple weeks
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition. Note it asks for as little as a couple of weeks, which is the smallest form of the revival ask in the corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a dream in which a leader addresses the nation announcing another virus, far worse than covid, with a death rate skyrocketing well above it.
mentions.quote: there's another virus and this made Co look like it was a wimpy virus
mentions.falsify_match: A televised national announcement of a new virus deadlier than covid.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such announcement. Undated, and reported as a dream rather than a word.

mentions.claim_text: Continuing the dream, he says the announcement called for a major lockdown and a halt to international flights in and out, and that he thought in the dream that he was not prepared enough.
mentions.quote: he was calling for a major lockdown
mentions.falsify_match: A national lockdown with international flights suspended.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such lockdown. This is the second covid-scale lockdown claim in the corpus and it remains undated.

mentions.claim_text: He recommends a fellow minister's forthcoming material about what is coming to America and describes meeting him in person.
mentions.quote: meeting him face to face is even better than getting to watch his videos
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a recommendation of someone else's ministry.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a Middle Eastern man with a large black beard who told him that another 9/11-type event was being planned in America, and says he does not know whether it is already planned or how long such a thing takes to prepare.
mentions.quote: they were planning in America another type of a 911 event
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated mass-casualty attack on American soil of September 11 scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack. Undated, and he says himself he has no timing.

mentions.claim_text: He recommends another man's dream about kicking the can, red dragons and food shortages, and says the Lord spoke to him through it.
mentions.quote: a really prophetic dream about uh food shortages
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: he is endorsing another person's dream, which under the corpus rule is not a word he gives.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord keeps telling him about a revival, and that he keeps seeing a major outpouring of grace greater than has ever been seen.
mentions.quote: a major major outpouring of the grace of God like we've never seen before
mentions.falsify_match: A revival exceeding any previously recorded.
mentions.falsify_miss: None comes. Greatest ever is a superlative with no measure attached, and the claim carries no date.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces a joint prayer session with named prayer partners and refers back to a vision he says he gave the audience almost a year earlier.
mentions.quote: I told you all back it's almost been a year ago about one of the visions
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: session framing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says Russia moves against Poland and that this is one of the main things that escalates into a world war through Europe, using a weapon never used before, and reports that when he assumed it was nuclear the Lord told him it was not a nuclear weapon.
mentions.quote: they would use a weapon that's never been used before on uh Poland
mentions.falsify_match: Russia uses a novel non-nuclear weapon against Poland, triggering a wider European war.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The explicit exclusion of a nuclear weapon is a real narrowing and makes this more checkable than most of the war material.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is an urgency to the prayer videos, that it is time to get serious about the coming of the Lord, and that against those who say it is years away he believes Jesus is coming very soon.
mentions.quote: I believe Jesus is coming and coming very soon
mentions.falsify_match: The return occurs.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Very soon carries no date and he marks it as belief rather than a word.

mentions.claim_text: He cites the hook in the jaw of Gog and Magog pulling Russia down, and says they are seeing that take place now through the major events.
mentions.quote: the hook in the mouth pulling Russia down and here we are
mentions.falsify_match: Russia leads a coalition against Israel as Ezekiel 38 describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Reading current events as the hook is interpretation, and the reading has been applied to Russia by successive writers since the Cold War.

mentions.claim_text: A worship and declaration segment over America with applause and little discernible speech.
mentions.quote: America America you shall be saved
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: worship and declaration.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told this would be a time of greater acceleration in the spirit realm across the economy, signs, politics and Israel, and being told to pay attention to the East, where he saw Chicago and Philadelphia and headlines through the summer.
mentions.quote: I want you to pay attention to the East
mentions.falsify_match: Major news events centred on Chicago and Philadelphia over the summer of 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: An ordinary summer in those cities. Note the Democratic convention was already scheduled for Chicago in August 2024 when this was given.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw record-breaking temperatures over the Philadelphia and New York area and the Northeast for the summer, lasting perhaps a week or a month, and that he was also told there would be record-breaking wind gusts.
mentions.quote: record-breaking temperatures for the summer in that area
mentions.falsify_match: Record high temperatures set in the Philadelphia and New York area during summer 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: No records set there. He declines to say how long it lasts, which loosens it, but record versus not is a published fact.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for authority to be taken over what he describes as a demonic agenda for mass shootings so that they stop, says it is worldwide rather than only American, and urges Psalm 91 protection at malls, large gatherings and soccer matches.
mentions.quote: take authority over the Demonic agenda for mass shootings
mentions.falsify_match: Mass shootings at large gatherings worldwide.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A petition rather than a forecast, and mass shootings at gatherings occur regularly regardless.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces a reaction video with a named prayer partner and explains that the prayer videos are made for people who feel dry and want to pray alongside others.
mentions.quote: I'm doing these videos for people who are dry
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: session framing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.
